newsitem.title: USA: U.S. unveils new laundry care symbols.
newsitem.headline: U.S. unveils new laundry care symbols.

text.p: United States clothing will begin carrying five kinds of new laundry care symbols immediately, industry representatives and government officials announced Tuesday.
The symbols resemble those used in Europe, as the United States begins to move toward universal, worldwide laundry care symbols, Federal Trade Commission officials said.
Manufacturers may continue to use laundry care wording instead of symbols. But if they use symbols, they must be uniform.
During an 18-month transition period, clothing will carry written explanations as well as the symbols.

The symbols -- including a circle to indicate dry cleaning, a bucket with water for machine wash, an iron for ironing and a triangle for bleach -- also carry dots and lines, indicating temperatures for clothing care and other information.
